Root cause: constant folding during compilation propagated exceptions raised by custom filters and tests when evaluating literal expressions.

final_text:
Root cause: constant folding during compilation propagated exceptions raised by custom filters and tests when evaluating literal expressions.

Changed `optimizer.py` to treat any regular exception during constant folding as a non-constant expression, deferring evaluation to render time. This preserves runtime errors in live branches while allowing dead branches and templates with failing literal expressions to load successfully.
